nodes.label: parse_args
nodes.desc: Argparse surface for training: model/pretrained, precision, batch size, data, distributed flags.

nodes.label: main(args)
nodes.desc: Single-process or torchrun entry: wires args to device, model, data, task, epochs and checkpoints.

nodes.label: setup_logging
nodes.desc: Text-file + console logging; master-rank-only log paths.

nodes.label: init_distributed_device
nodes.desc: Initializes torch.distributed from torchrun/SLURM env vars and picks the nccl/gloo/hccl backend.

nodes.label: push_to_hf_hub
nodes.desc: Exports model, config and tokenizer assets to a HuggingFace Hub repo.

nodes.label: create_model_and_transforms
nodes.desc: One-stop factory: config resolution, create_model with load_checkpoint (safetensors/torch.load, pos-embed resize), preprocess build.

nodes.label: _PRETRAINED registry
nodes.desc: Hundreds of curated checkpoint configs; get_pretrained_cfg / download_pretrained fetch and cache weights.

nodes.label: convert_state_dict
nodes.desc: Detects third-party checkpoints (big_vision npz, MobileCLIP, MaMMUT forks) and remaps keys.

nodes.label: traits_from_config
nodes.desc: Classifies a config into a ModelFamily and derives input mode, pooling and loss-family facts.

nodes.label: CLIP / CustomTextCLIP
nodes.desc: Dual-tower implementations: encode_image/encode_text, logit_scale, tower locking, half-precision weight conversion.

nodes.label: VisionTransformer
nodes.desc: ViT image tower; the same file hosts TextTransformer, Attention, ResidualAttentionBlock and ModernTextTransformer.

nodes.label: TimmModel
nodes.desc: Turns any timm classification backbone into a CLIP vision tower.

nodes.label: HFTextEncoder
nodes.desc: HuggingFace encoder as text tower with mean/cls poolers plus MLP projection.

nodes.label: ModifiedResNet
nodes.desc: OpenAI-style conv-attention ResNet behind RN50/RN101 configs.

nodes.label: CoCa
nodes.desc: Contrastive + captioning heads over a multimodal decoder.

nodes.label: CLAP
nodes.desc: Audio-text contrastive model reusing the same factory and config schema.

nodes.label: HFTokenizer
nodes.desc: Bridges transformers AutoTokenizer; SimpleTokenizer keeps the original CLIP BPE; SigLIP and TikToken variants.

nodes.label: image_transform_v2
nodes.desc: Resize/crop/normalize built from PreprocessCfg plus AugmentationCfg for training.

nodes.label: TrainingTask
nodes.desc: Base nn.Module contract: prepare_batch, forward returning a losses dict, train/eval switching.

nodes.label: CLIPTask
nodes.desc: Contrastive image-text task: tower forward, feature gather across ranks, logit-scale clamp.

nodes.label: ClipLoss / SigLipLoss
nodes.desc: Symmetric cross-entropy with optional local-loss rank slicing; pairwise sigmoid SigLIP variant.

nodes.label: get_data
nodes.desc: WebDataset/csv loaders, real-up sampler, distributed shuffle and epoch state.

nodes.label: create_optimizer
nodes.desc: Param groups with weight-decay exclusions and optional layer-wise LR decay.

nodes.label: cosine_lr
nodes.desc: Warmup + cosine step schedule invoked once per batch.

nodes.label: get_autocast
nodes.desc: Maps --precision to autocast and input dtypes (amp, bf16, pure fp16...).

nodes.label: train_one_epoch
nodes.desc: Step loop: scheduler tick, prepare batch, eager or compiled train step, loss all-reduce, meters.

nodes.label: random_seed / AverageMeter
nodes.desc: Seeding, metric meters and checkpoint helpers.

nodes.label: zero_shot_eval
nodes.desc: Runs ImageNet and other benchmark zero-shot suites after each epoch when requested.

nodes.label: build_zero_shot_classifier
nodes.desc: Encodes prompt templates into class-weight embeddings.

nodes.label: OPENAI_IMAGENET_TEMPLATES
nodes.desc: The 80-prompt ImageNet template set and class-name list.
